cloudwatch.reading: No 502 and no function errors after 9dfb755; the 11 failures are Lambda throttles at 80 instances in the first minute. First requests on new instances wait up to ~8.8 s on the free Atlas cluster (100 operations/s), longer than the client's three retries (~3.5 s).
